name: Not Of This World
description:
Even as you walk in this world, you are bound by strands to another, which underlies the world we know.

You gain 1 rank in Spirit.

Once per rest, you may spend an action to open your senses, sensing nearby deities and magical beings. You get a vague sense of their power, domain or general intent. When you attempt to communicate with, influence or request a favor from such beings, your skill checks are favored.

Describe how your connection manifests.

Your ties to another world prevent you from following fully the ways of this one. Choose one permanent effect:

  • You cannot fall asleep in a bed.

  • You cannot use utensils to eat food.

  • You cannot enter a dwelling uninvited.

Describe how you navigate this limitation.
